title: Baby Boxer Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a muscular baby wearing silver boxing gear and shorts are displayed in a horizontal strip against bright pink backgrounds. The framed artwork rests on a textured hot pink surface with large black stenciled text visible behind it.
prompt: A horizontal sequence of four animated poses showing the same muscular baby boxer wearing silver shorts, gloves and headgear, throwing punches in different stances, each pose set inside its own bright pink rectangle, arranged side by side on a white panel, the entire piece placed over a vibrant textured pink background with large black stenciled lettering partially visible behind it
